description: This file provides utility functions for creating and managing communication endpoints using MessagePorts in a web extension context, including serialization/deserialization and forwarding of messages.

methods.name: _resolvePort
methods.description: Resolves a port by connecting to the extension runtime with a given ID.

methods.name: _deserializePort
methods.description: Creates a pair of MessagePorts and forwards messages between them.

methods.name: createEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a communication endpoint over a given port with serialization/deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Forwards messages between a MessagePort and an extension Port.

methods.name: isMessagePort
methods.description: Checks if a port is a message port based on its name.

methods.name: createBackgroundEndpoint
methods.description: Creates an extension endpoint from a runtime port.
